novel_features.name: Compliance Audit
novel_features.description: Surface every employee below a completion threshold, grouped by role — the Monday compliance check in one command.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining users, subjects, roles, and completion data across local SQLite tables; no single API call provides this cross-entity view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to identify training compliance gaps across an organization without clicking through dozens of Trainual UI screens.

novel_features.name: Assignment Gap Detector
novel_features.description: Detect users missing subject assignments that peers in their role have — catch forgotten onboarding assignments before managers complain.
novel_features.rationale: Computes set-difference across role memberships and subject assignments in local SQLite; the API has no endpoint for 'what's missing'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to verify assignment completeness across roles — catches partial gaps, not just fully unassigned users.

novel_features.name: Content Quality Audit
novel_features.description: List all curriculums with course counts, test counts, and enrollment — flag empty, untested, and orphaned content in one table.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates counts across subjects, topics, tests, and enrollment in local SQLite; requires clicking through each curriculum individually in the web UI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to identify structural training content problems (empty curriculums, missing tests) across the entire content library.

novel_features.name: Onboarding Progress Tracker
novel_features.description: Show new hires from the last N days with their assignment completeness and completion percentage, grouped by role.
novel_features.rationale: Filters users by creation date and joins to assignments and completion data in local SQLite; no API endpoint provides a cohort onboarding view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to check whether recent hires are on track with their training assignments.

novel_features.name: Training Coverage Matrix
novel_features.description: Produce a role-by-subject matrix showing completion percentage per cell — the exact report ops managers build by hand in Excel.
novel_features.rationale: Pivots users across roles and subjects in local SQLite with aggregate completion; requires manual spreadsheet work without this command.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs a complete training coverage snapshot across all roles and subjects in one structured output.

novel_features.name: Role Completion Leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank roles by average completion percentage — instantly see which venues or teams are ahead or behind.
novel_features.rationale: Groups users by role and computes AVG(completion_percentage) in local SQLite; no API endpoint provides role-level aggregation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to compare training progress across organizational units (venues, departments, teams).

novel_features.name: Completion Trend Tracker
novel_features.description: Show how a user's completion percentage has changed over successive syncs — week-over-week training progress.
novel_features.rationale: Reads timestamped completion snapshots from a local sync_history table; the API provides no historical completion data.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to track whether a flagged employee's training is actually improving over time.

novel_features.name: Bulk Role-Based Assignment
novel_features.description: Assign subjects to all users in a role with one command — the role-based fan-out that individual assign-subjects can't do.
novel_features.rationale: Lists users by role from local SQLite, then calls the assign_subjects API for each user; combines local data with API writes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to ensure all members of a role have consistent subject assignments without iterating manually.

narrative.headline: Every Trainual feature plus compliance audit, assignment gap detection, and training analytics no other tool provides.
narrative.value_prop: Sync your entire Trainual account to a local SQLite database, then run compliance audits, detect assignment gaps, and produce coverage matrices that would take hours of manual spreadsheet work. Works offline, pipes to jq, and outputs agent-native JSON.
narrative.auth_narrative: Trainual uses Bearer token authentication. Generate your API key in Trainual Settings > Integrations > API, then set TRAINUAL_API_KEY in your environment.

quickstart.comment: Verify API key is valid and Trainual is reachable
Pull all users, subjects, topics, tests, and roles into local SQLite
See who's behind on training across all curriculums
Detect users missing assignments their peers have
Role-by-subject completion matrix for stakeholder reporting

troubleshoots.fix: Regenerate your API key in Trainual Settings > Integrations > API and update TRAINUAL_API_KEY

troubleshoots.symptom: completion_percentage shows 0 for users with progress
troubleshoots.fix: Use completion_percentage field (not avg_completion which is broken in the Trainual API)
Trainual API paginates at 50/page max. Large orgs (500+ users) may take a few minutes on first sync.
Some roles intentionally have different subject sets. Use --role to scope to a specific role for accurate gap detection.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need training compliance data, onboarding tracking, or content quality audits for a Trainual account. It is the right choice for any task that requires correlating users, subjects, roles, and completion data — questions the Trainual web UI cannot answer without manual spreadsheet work.
